key_insight: SymPlex discovers closed-form symbolic solutions to PDEs without ground-truth formulas by treating expression generation as a tree-structured decision process and optimizing candidate trees directly against the PDE and boundary conditions using reinforcement learning.
problem_solved: Finding analytic symbolic solutions for PDEs is hard when no reference expressions exist; prior methods rely on supervised data or numeric approximations. SymPlex enables automated discovery of valid, human-readable PDE solutions using only the equation and boundary/initial conditions.
method: Formulate symbolic PDE solving as tree-structured decision-making and search: generate expression trees token-by-token and evaluate them as candidate solutions.
Introduce SymFormer, a structure-aware Transformer with tree-relative self-attention that models hierarchical dependencies and enforces syntactic correctness of expression trees.
Use reinforcement learning to optimize candidates by scoring them with PDE residuals and boundary-condition penalties (no ground-truth expressions required).
impact: Enables automated discovery of interpretable analytical PDE solutions that can complement numerical solvers and support physics-informed modeling; useful for scientific ML, symbolic regression, and interpretable modeling in engineering and physics.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram of SymFormer showing expression tree input, tree-relative self-attention, and output token decisions.
RL optimization loop flowchart: propose expression tree → evaluate PDE residual & boundary loss → compute reward → policy update.
Before/after examples: numeric PDE solution vs discovered symbolic expression (with residual error metric).
Bar or line chart comparing success rate or residual error of SymPlex vs baseline symbolic/numeric methods.
paper_title: SymPlex: A Structure-Aware Transformer for Symbolic PDE Solving
paper_authors: Yesom Park, Annie C. Lu, Shao-Ching Huang, Qiyang Hu, Y. Sungtaek Ju
